mechanism: A violent late-July up-pulse (+55% in four sessions, 4.5 to 7.00) rode on breaking structure: S_UF sagged to 0.726, URF pinned at 0.000, five channel deaths per session at the top, with displacement already pointing down on every reading. The field re-knit for two weeks while price was distributed sideways below the pulse high, then a second push into 7.00 on 08-18 broke it again — URF=0.000 with a channel dying at the close and at the next open — and the final session displaced downward on all five readings (D- 5/5) while price stalled at 6.89. Each attempt to hold the pulse high costs channel deaths; the pulse's energy is exhausted and the stored tension points back toward the pre-pulse 4.5-5.9 shelf.
